```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Project root is ~/code; this Rmd lives in ~/code/notebooks/.
# Run chunks as if we were at the project root.
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/code")
```

## Run the pipeline

```{r run}
source("code/scripts/01_gen_h18b.R")
```

## Load and inspect the result

```{r inspect}
source("code/R/logging.R")
source("code/R/io.R")

s <- load_scenario("H18-B", "default")
str(s, max.level = 1)

values <- s$values[, 1]
summary(values)
```

## Plot it

```{r plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
plot(
  s$locations[, 1], s$locations[, 2],
  pch = 19,
  cex = 1 + 2 * values / max(values),
  col = gray(1 - values / max(values)),
  xlab = "x", ylab = "y",
  main = "H18-B simulated counts"
)
```
